required_artifacts: Actual shared API client; Overview/Terms/Processes/Map shell; accessible search; faithful entry and source drawer; configured supported process projection; shared-model List and lazy bounded Cytoscape renderer; responsive state/feedback/history; production assets and direct current functional browser evidence for every29 criterion.
frozen_consumers: Use accepted contracts.ts/state.ts/routes.ts/preferences.ts/model.ts as pure foundation APIs. These are owned delivered files; route any defects to their existing owner. The frontend owns api.ts and actual browser/DOM integration.
Use accepted Reader process projection in ontology_explorer_read.py. The planned process helper function is integrated there; do not invent a second inference layer based on types or labels.

Map data uses the accepted pure src/model.ts. Map/List both consume identical admitted identities/qualifiers/sources/limits, including consuming detail markers. A separate data module may adapt calls but must not fork semantics.
